rules.description: Repeated normalized instruction text; not semantic duplication.
Explicit API parameter assignment or protocol mention; may be legitimate project documentation.
Repeated review or zero-findings language; review necessity and project policy require context.
Unconditional repeated file-read requirement; consider only if model scope applies.
Potentially broad routine-step approval requirement; genuine authorization boundaries must remain.
Physical line count is a local triage threshold, not a vendor limit.
Exact registered model identifier mentioned outside selected profile; inspect context; no incompatibility claim.
Literal comparison only; unmatched guidance is not missing or violated.
